'''Mullmoy''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[doctor]] that worked<ref name="Episode10" /> on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]]<ref name="Kassa">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|110}}</ref> as [[Maarva Carassi Andor]]'s health began to decline, Mullmoy approached the [[Andor household]] to check on Maarva. As he approached the residence, [[Jezzi]], a [[Daughter of Ferrix]], told Mullmoy that Maarva refused to eat her pills prescribed to her by Mullmoy.<ref name="Episode10" /> Eventually, Maarva [[Death|passed away]]<ref name="Daughter">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref> and a [[funeral]] was held for her. During her [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]], Mullmoy played an instrument while walking towards [[Rix Road]].<ref name="Rix Road" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Mullmoy appeared in two episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''. He was portrayed by the series' orchestra conductor, [[Matt Dunkley]], in a [[List of cameos in Star Wars|cameo]] role.<ref name="Episode10" />
